title: 金壇鹽穴壓縮空氣儲能電站
titleEn: Jintan Salt-Cavern Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant
subcategoryTitleEn: Landmark storage, transmission and hydrogen projects
summary: 江蘇常州金壇的鹽礦採了幾十年，在地下一千公尺留下許多巨大的空腔。金壇壓縮空氣儲能電站利用其中一個約 22 萬立方公尺的鹽穴，一期 60 MW、300 MWh，2022 年投入商轉，是中國第一座不燃燒燃料的大型壓縮空氣儲能電站：壓縮時產生的熱用導熱油存起來，放電時再用來加熱空氣。課程定量分析充放電的功率配置、洞穴的工作氣量、壓縮熱的溫度與蓄熱量、往返效率，以及洞穴壓力的上限與鹽岩的潛變。
summaryEn: Decades of salt mining at Jintan in Changzhou, Jiangsu, left many huge cavities a thousand metres underground. The Jintan compressed air energy storage plant uses one of about 220,000 cubic metres; its first phase of 60 MW and 300 MWh entered service in 2022 as China's first large compressed air storage plant burning no fuel, heat of compression being stored in thermal oil and used to reheat air on discharge. The course quantifies charge and discharge power, working gas of the cavern, temperature and quantity of compression heat, round-trip efficiency, and the pressure ceiling and creep of salt.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

v30FocusEn: Salt-cavern compressed air storage that burns no fuel: charge and discharge power, temperature of compression heat, thermal-oil storage, cavern pressure and salt creep

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：金壇鹽穴壓縮空氣儲能電站
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Jintan Salt-Cavern Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「等溫壓縮功」與「充電功率的配置」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Isothermal compression work" and "Sizing the charging power": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「等溫壓縮功」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Isothermal compression work" is correct?
options: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。
壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。
儲能設備充電與放電的功率一定相同。
optionsEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed.
Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues.
Storage always charges and discharges at the same power.
quiz.explanation: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「等溫壓縮功」如何決定「金壇鹽穴壓縮空氣儲能電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isothermal compression work” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Jintan Salt-Cavern Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。把氣體由常壓壓到高壓所需的最小功是等溫過程的功，與絕對溫度及壓力比的自然對數成正比。實際壓縮機接近絕熱，空氣溫度可升到數百度：若這些壓縮熱被冷卻器丟棄，放電時就必須燃燒天然氣重新加熱；若把熱存起來再利用，就是不補燃的絕熱式系統。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed. The minimum work to compress a gas from ambient to high pressure is that of an isothermal process, proportional to absolute temperature and the natural logarithm of pressure ratio. Real compressors are nearly adiabatic and air reaches hundreds of degrees: if that heat is discarded in coolers, natural gas must be burned to reheat the air on discharge; storing and reusing it gives an adiabatic system without firing. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：一期工程的規模為 60 MW、300 MWh
steps.observationEn: Project file: The first phase is 60 MW and 300 MWh
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「等溫壓縮功」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Isothermal compression work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 等溫壓縮功
knowledge.text: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。把氣體由常壓壓到高壓所需的最小功是等溫過程的功，與絕對溫度及壓力比的自然對數成正比。實際壓縮機接近絕熱，空氣溫度可升到數百度：若這些壓縮熱被冷卻器丟棄，放電時就必須燃燒天然氣重新加熱；若把熱存起來再利用，就是不補燃的絕熱式系統。
knowledge.textEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed. The minimum work to compress a gas from ambient to high pressure is that of an isothermal process, proportional to absolute temperature and the natural logarithm of pressure ratio. Real compressors are nearly adiabatic and air reaches hundreds of degrees: if that heat is discarded in coolers, natural gas must be burned to reheat the air on discharge; storing and reusing it gives an adiabatic system without firing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 一期工程的規模為 60 MW、300 MWh
knowledge.textEn: The first phase is 60 MW and 300 MWh

quiz.question: 依「等溫壓縮功」的模型 w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)，把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁) for "Isothermal compression work", which value is closest to the work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure?
options: 212 kJ/kg
424 kJ/kg
4,244 kJ/kg
optionsEn: 212 kJ/kg
424 kJ/kg
4,244 kJ/kg
quiz.explanation: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)；代入 Tk = 300 K、pmax = 140 bar，得 424 kJ/kg（把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁); with Tk = 300 K, pmax = 140 bar the result is 424 kJ/kg (work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「等溫壓縮功」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Isothermal compression work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)；代入 Tk = 300 K、pmax = 140 bar，得 424 kJ/kg（把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 pmax 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁); with Tk = 300 K, pmax = 140 bar the result is 424 kJ/kg (work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise pmax by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：pmax 增加 10% 時，結果變為 433 kJ/kg（+1.9%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising pmax by 10% changes the result to 433 kJ/kg (+1.9%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 424 kJ/kg（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 pmax 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 424 kJ/kg (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in pmax with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)；代入 Tk = 300 K、pmax = 140 bar，得 424 kJ/kg（把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功）。
knowledge.textEn: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁); with Tk = 300 K, pmax = 140 bar the result is 424 kJ/kg (work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: pmax 增加 10% 時，結果變為 433 kJ/kg（+1.9%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising pmax by 10% changes the result to 433 kJ/kg (+1.9%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「等溫壓縮功」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Isothermal compression work"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
一度電的熱和一度電的電價值完全相同。
量測壓縮機各級的進出口壓力、溫度、流量與驅動功率，計算多變效率與中間冷卻器的移熱量，並與等溫功比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A kilowatt-hour of heat is worth exactly the same as a kilowatt-hour of electricity.
Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work.
quiz.explanation: 量測壓縮機各級的進出口壓力、溫度、流量與驅動功率，計算多變效率與中間冷卻器的移熱量，並與等溫功比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「等溫壓縮功」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isothermal compression work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測壓縮機各級的進出口壓力、溫度、流量與驅動功率，計算多變效率與中間冷卻器的移熱量，並與等溫功比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：系統效率的邊界要明定是否計入壓縮熱回收與補燃燃料，不同類型的壓縮空氣儲能不能直接比較單一效率數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The efficiency boundary must state whether compression-heat recovery and firing fuel are counted; different CAES types cannot be compared by one efficiency number.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測壓縮機各級的進出口壓力、溫度、流量與驅動功率，計算多變效率與中間冷卻器的移熱量，並與等溫功比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work.

knowledge.text: 系統效率的邊界要明定是否計入壓縮熱回收與補燃燃料，不同類型的壓縮空氣儲能不能直接比較單一效率數字。
knowledge.textEn: The efficiency boundary must state whether compression-heat recovery and firing fuel are counted; different CAES types cannot be compared by one efficiency number.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62271 高壓開關設備與控制設備。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62271 High-voltage switchgear and controlgear. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「等溫壓縮功」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Isothermal compression work" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
儲能設備充電與放電的功率一定相同。
optionsEn: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Storage always charges and discharges at the same power.
quiz.explanation: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「等溫壓縮功」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Isothermal compression work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「金壇鹽穴壓縮空氣儲能電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Jintan Salt-Cavern Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際壓縮機接近絕熱，空氣溫度可升到數百度：若這些壓縮熱被冷卻器丟棄，放電時就必須燃燒天然氣重新加熱；若把熱存起來再利用，就是不補燃的絕熱式系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Real compressors are nearly adiabatic and air reaches hundreds of degrees: if that heat is discarded in coolers, natural gas must be burned to reheat the air on discharge; storing and reusing it gives an adiabatic system without firing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability.

quiz.question: 關於「充電功率的配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sizing the charging power" is correct?
options: 儲能設備充電與放電的功率一定相同。
洞穴裡的空氣可以全部放光再重新灌滿。
這座電站放電五小時、充電卻要八小時，兩者並不對稱。
optionsEn: Storage always charges and discharges at the same power.
All the air in a cavern can be released and the cavern refilled from empty.
This plant discharges for five hours yet charges for eight, the two being unequal.
quiz.explanation: 這座電站放電五小時、充電卻要八小時，兩者並不對稱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: This plant discharges for five hours yet charges for eight, the two being unequal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 充電功率的配置：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Sizing the charging power: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「充電功率的配置」如何決定「金壇鹽穴壓縮空氣儲能電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sizing the charging power” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Jintan Salt-Cavern Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 這座電站放電五小時、充電卻要八小時，兩者並不對稱。原因是往返效率只有六成：要放出三百 MWh，就得充進五百 MWh。如果壓縮機與發電機一樣大，充電要八個多小時；把充電時間定為夜間離峰的八小時，就可以算出壓縮機需要的功率。壓縮機與膨脹機是兩套獨立的機器，這是壓縮空氣儲能與電池不同的地方：充電功率、放電功率與儲存的能量三者可以各自決定，各取所需。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: This plant discharges for five hours yet charges for eight, the two being unequal. The reason is a round-trip efficiency of only six tenths: to give 300 MWh it must take in 500. With compressor and generator the same size charging takes over eight hours, and fixing charge at the eight off-peak night hours gives compressor power needed. Compressor and expander are two separate machine sets, which is where compressed air differs from batteries: charging power, discharging power and energy stored can each be chosen to suit. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：2022 年 5 月投入商業運轉
steps.observationEn: Project file: It entered commercial operation in May 2022
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲能設備充電與放電的功率一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Storage always charges and discharges at the same power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「充電功率的配置」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Sizing the charging power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 這座電站放電五小時、充電卻要八小時，兩者並不對稱。原因是往返效率只有六成：要放出三百 MWh，就得充進五百 MWh。如果壓縮機與發電機一樣大，充電要八個多小時；把充電時間定為夜間離峰的八小時，就可以算出壓縮機需要的功率。壓縮機與膨脹機是兩套獨立的機器，這是壓縮空氣儲能與電池不同的地方：充電功率、放電功率與儲存的能量三者可以各自決定，各取所需。
knowledge.textEn: This plant discharges for five hours yet charges for eight, the two being unequal. The reason is a round-trip efficiency of only six tenths: to give 300 MWh it must take in 500. With compressor and generator the same size charging takes over eight hours, and fixing charge at the eight off-peak night hours gives compressor power needed. Compressor and expander are two separate machine sets, which is where compressed air differs from batteries: charging power, discharging power and energy stored can each be chosen to suit.

knowledge.text: 誤解：儲能設備充電與放電的功率一定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「充電功率的配置」的模型 P_c = E / (η·t_c)，放電 300 MWh、往返效率 0.60、充電 8 小時時壓縮機的平均功率最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P_c = E / (η·t_c) for "Sizing the charging power", which value is closest to the mean compressor power to deliver 300 MWh at 0.60 round-trip efficiency with 8 hours of charging?
options: 625 MW
optionsEn: 625 MW
quiz.explanation: P_c = E / (η·t_c)；代入 E = 300 MWh、η = 0.6、tc = 8 h，得 62.5 MW（放電 300 MWh、往返效率 0.60、充電 8 小時時壓縮機的平均功率）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P_c = E / (η·t_c); with E = 300 MWh, η = 0.6, tc = 8 h the result is 62.5 MW (mean compressor power to deliver 300 MWh at 0.60 round-trip efficiency with 8 hours of charging). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 充電功率的配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sizing the charging power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「充電功率的配置」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Sizing the charging power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P_c = E / (η·t_c)；代入 E = 300 MWh、η = 0.6、tc = 8 h，得 62.5 MW（放電 300 MWh、往返效率 0.60、充電 8 小時時壓縮機的平均功率）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 tc 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P_c = E / (η·t_c); with E = 300 MWh, η = 0.6, tc = 8 h the result is 62.5 MW (mean compressor power to deliver 300 MWh at 0.60 round-trip efficiency with 8 hours of charging). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise tc by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：tc 增加 10% 時，結果變為 56.8 MW（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising tc by 10% changes the result to 56.8 MW (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 62.5 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 tc 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 62.5 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in tc with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P_c = E / (η·t_c)；代入 E = 300 MWh、η = 0.6、tc = 8 h，得 62.5 MW（放電 300 MWh、往返效率 0.60、充電 8 小時時壓縮機的平均功率）。
knowledge.textEn: P_c = E / (η·t_c); with E = 300 MWh, η = 0.6, tc = 8 h the result is 62.5 MW (mean compressor power to deliver 300 MWh at 0.60 round-trip efficiency with 8 hours of charging).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: tc 增加 10% 時，結果變為 56.8 MW（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising tc by 10% changes the result to 56.8 MW (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「充電功率的配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sizing the charging power"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以完整的充放電循環量測壓縮機的耗電量與發電機的輸出電量，並記錄各自的運轉時數。
效率只有六成的儲能技術沒有實用價值。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Full cycles are metered for compressor energy in and generator energy out, with running hours of each logged.
Storage only sixty percent efficient has no practical value.
quiz.explanation: 以完整的充放電循環量測壓縮機的耗電量與發電機的輸出電量，並記錄各自的運轉時數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Full cycles are metered for compressor energy in and generator energy out, with running hours of each logged. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 充電功率的配置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sizing the charging power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「充電功率的配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sizing the charging power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以完整的充放電循環量測壓縮機的耗電量與發電機的輸出電量，並記錄各自的運轉時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Full cycles are metered for compressor energy in and generator energy out, with running hours of each logged. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：壓縮機與膨脹機的容量要分別依充電與放電的時段長度決定，並預留電價型態改變後的彈性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Size compressor and expander separately for the lengths of charging and discharging windows, leaving flexibility for changing price patterns.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：離峰時段隨著太陽能的增加而由夜間移到中午且變短時，原本依八小時設計的壓縮機來不及把洞穴充滿。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: As the off-peak period moves from night to midday and shortens with more solar, a compressor sized for eight hours cannot fill the cavern in time. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
